title: Understanding Precision
text: Precision is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total number of positive predictions (true positives + false positives).

title: Identify True Positives and False Positives
text: For Model C, a prediction is positive (1) if the predicted probability is greater than or equal to $$0.75$$. Identify which observations meet this criterion and check their true labels.

title: Calculate True Positives
text: How many observations have a predicted probability greater than or equal to $$0.75$$ and a true label of 1?

title: Calculate False Positives
text: How many observations have a predicted probability greater than or equal to $$0.75$$ and a true label of 0?

title: Compute Precision
text: Use the formula for precision: true positives divided by the sum of true positives and false positives.
